data.desc: Kyntra Bio is a pure play, rare disease biopharmaceutical company focused on the development of roxadustat for anemia associated with lower-risk myelodysplastic syndromes (LR-MDS). Roxadustat (, EVRENZO) is currently approved in Europe, Japan, China, and numerous other countries for the treatment of anemia in chronic kidney disease (CKD) patients on dialysis and not on dialysis. The Company is planning to study roxadustat in a pivotal Phase 3 trial in patients with anemia associated with lower-risk myelodysplastic syndromes (LR-MDS).
